parole.significato: To quarrel in a tiresome, insulting manner.

parole.significato: A type of linen cloth, originally from Holland.
parole.testo: After Holland, where it originally came from. From Old Dutch holt lant (“wood land”).

parole.significato: A small peg used for playing a game or for keeping score, as in cribbage.
parole.testo: From Old Dutch spelleken (“a small pin”). Compare English spill.

parole.significato: To play (with) in an idle or desultory way.
